note: Board commits after f37a6da do not change src. Canvas screenshots exclude the HTML HUD. Status clocks are the DOM text in inspect.json. No date jump. ?hour= sets the dial (initDay) and the world then runs.
convention: sunPosition is local solar hour, Spencer 1971 declination at noon, 49.5 N. weather.solar is civil time. sky.update passes hour only, so the rendered sun stays on DAY_OF_YEAR (T-0022).

sunGate.metric: centroid of canvas pixels with min(R,G,B)>=250, versus the screen point from sunPosition at the HUD minute, yaw fixed at the hour-7 azimuth, look elevation +20 deg after a full ArrowUp, vertical FOV 48 deg
sunGate.knownMismatch: weather.solar civil elevation 18.574 deg at the same minute would sit near y=286, 40 px below the core. That core would miss. Luminance in cd/m2 is not scored: the frame is tonemapped sRGB.
